collectValue: One value: a simple one — a leaf; a record — descend into it (if depth allows); an array — element by element (element keys are numbers: t.price[3], t.weapon[0].damage). Arrays with unknown bounds are skipped.
state.list: All elements of an array: state.list("gMap.players") — a list of records (or values).
state.set: The code is kept constant and the value is passed as an argument: this way the game compiles it only once.
screens.button: The button name by tag; for unknown ones — the number as a string.
screens.of: The screen name by state name: "EventMainMenu" / "ShowMainMenu" -> "MainMenu".
screens.bind: A per-mod copy: hooks go through the mod's ui and are removed when it unloads. Called by the modloader when it creates the mod environment; you do not need to call it yourself.
balance.refresh: The type list is built on first use; after the set of nations changes in a new match — reset it.
balance.find: The first match: nation and type number. Other nations with the same name — balance.places(sid).
balance.setSpeed: In the game, speed is a multiplier of the step interval (smaller — faster); here it is an ordinary speed multiplier.
buildings.setProduceList: A new list for all nations that have this building. Button positions (x, y) — a grid of 6 per row, like the game.
buildings.setUpgrade: An upgrade field for all nations that have it: "time", "value", "price[3]", "enabled", "level".
objects.ptr: Like _unit_GetTObj: the object's state data, argument gc_argunit_obj (= 0).
objects.calibrate: Verification on several objects: the layout must match on all of them, otherwise zeros in fields could be mistaken for a correct one.
